applies_to: Berner air curtains with the Berner AIR WCA BACnet interface (software 2.33).
summary: The Berner AIR WCA interface puts a Berner air curtain on BACnet IP as an application specific controller (B-ASC). It exposes 11 objects: the mode, fan speed and time delay commands, a weekly operating-hours schedule, door status and door-open count, an operating status, and on heated models a temperature setpoint and door temperature in both °F and °C.
notes: From the PICS object blocks; each object's present value is marked RO or RW.
AV 1-2 and AI 1-2 exist on heated models only.
The number of Mode states (2-4) and the fan speed maximum (1, 2, 3 or 10) depend on the air curtain model.
Most objects report Out_Of_Service = true when the WCA is not connected to the IntelliSwitch.

integration.summary: Write MV 1 Mode (Off/On/Auto/Comfort+) and PIV 2 FanSpeed, and on heated models the setpoint AV 1 (°F) or AV 2 (°C). The SCH 1 OperatingHours schedule drives BI 2 OperatingStatus. Read BI 1 DoorStatus and the door temperature.
integration.enable: MV 1 Mode selects Off (1), On (2), Auto (3) or Comfort+ (4); the number of available states depends on the model.
setup: BACnet IP, also as a foreign device.
gotchas: Most objects go Out_Of_Service when the WCA loses its IntelliSwitch connection.
AV 1 (°F) and AV 2 (°C) are both the temperature setpoint; map the one in your BMS units.

points.name: Mode
points.description: Air curtain mode; 2-4 states by model

points.name: TimeDelay
points.description: Time delay for the selected mode, 0-300 s
